title: Privacy policy

seo.title: Privacy policy - Test-English
seo.description: Learn how Test-English.com handles your data in compliance with GDPR. Read our Privacy Policy to understand data protection and your rights.

html:
Privacy and Data Protection at Test-English.com

Test-English complies with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) 2018. This Privacy Policy explains how we handle information collected during your visit to our website.

Information We Collect

The type of information we gather depends on your activity on our site. We collect data at two levels:

  • Non-personal information collected as you browse our website.
  • Personal information you provide knowingly.

Non-Personal Information

Non-personal information is not linked to a specific identity. We use Google Analytics to collect and analyze web statistics. This helps us understand visitor profiles and activity, allowing us to improve our content based on market demands.

Our website also uses cookies. Cookies are small, encrypted data files stored on your device by our server. They contain a unique user ID but do not access or compromise the data on your device.

Third-party advertising companies may use cookies to serve ads when you visit our site. These companies use information about your browsing (excluding personal details) to display ads tailored to your interests. Google and its partners may use cookies for personalized ads based on your activity across websites. You can opt out of personalized ads through Ads Settings.

See our Cookie Policy here.

IP addresses are not linked to personal details. We use IP addresses to analyze trends, manage the site, track general user movements, and gather demographic data for aggregate use.

Personal Information

Personal information relates to your name or identity. We only collect it when you contact us through our contact page. This may include your name, email address, and other contact details. We use this information to respond to your inquiries about our services.

Sharing Information with Other Parties

We do not sell, rent, or lease your personal information. We only share it with third parties if you specifically request us to do so.

Keeping Your Information Secure

Test-English is dedicated to protecting your information. We take reasonable security measures to prevent the loss, unauthorized access, misuse, modification, or disclosure of your personal information. However, as permitted by law, we cannot be held responsible for unauthorized access to information we hold.

This Privacy Policy may be updated periodically. If you have questions about this document or our terms of use, please contact us.
